tools.name: find_airports
tools.description: Find airports and city codes for your trip using Mubboo Flights. Search by place name or IATA code and choose the intended location when several suggestions match. Results identify locations; flight availability is checked separately.

tools.name: prepare_flight_search
tools.description: Prepare a personalized Mubboo Flights search for one-way, round-trip or multi-city travel. Validate airports, dates, passengers, cabin, language and currency, then return a search link. The traveler opens the link to compare current options; this tool returns search details rather than quotes or res

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Explore Mubboo Flights services, available MCP tools, travel product links and support. Includes connection details and commercial information. The website also offers hotels, car rentals, tours and travel research.
